newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai stocks close higher on foreign buying.
newsitem.headline: Thai stocks close higher on foreign buying.

text.p: Thai stocks closed moderately higher on Friday on foreign bargain hunting for discounted bank and finance issues, brokers said on Friday.
The SET index ended 9.98 points higher at 832.55 on sluggish 3.1 billion baht turnover. Bank and finance counters gained 1.36 percent and 1.23 percent respectively.
"Foreign investors see banks and finance firms as good buys after their recent sharp adjustments," said a broker at First Asia Securities.
Foreigners were net buyers of 402 million baht of Thai stocks on Thursday .
The Friday advance came despite expectations that banks and finance companies would post weak fourth quarter earnings from next Tuesday.
The two sectors account for nearly 40 percent of total market capitalisation.
Krung Thai Bank topped the active list, rallying one baht to 53, Finance One gained 0.75 to 46.75, and TelecomAsia advanced 0.50 to 52.
